surface: ChatGPT Work Mode with Codex agent, functions orchestration, shell and connectors
model: GPT-6 family per runtime role; precise deployed model ID/effort unobserved

source.access_mode: fresh shallow Git checkout; direct curl pinned-file read and GitHub connector reads also succeeded

discovery.interface: ALL_TOOLS plus directly exposed tool namespaces
discovery.deferred: All current registry names/descriptions enumerated; only relevant schemas read. No separate tool_search exposed. Runtime tools may change; backend tools outside current registry unknown.
discovery.scope: Current agent only, not account-wide or product-wide capability

timing.measurement_scope: Starts within first orchestration call after initial local inventory; excludes initial response/read overhead and subsequent ZIP upload. Total hard cap 300 seconds.

probes.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git branch --show-current; git status --short
probes.result: expected SHA; assigned branch; empty status output; exit 0
pinned runbook and AGENTS.md successful; encoded branch API URL rejected
README.md and cloud-workflow.md at pinned ref successful
exact branch found; result has no commit SHA; pagination not exhausted

probes.command: rg --files instruction lookup; cat focused instructions; shutil.which selected shell programs
probes.result: successful; nested example AGENTS not applicable; no task-directory override found

probes.command: initial rg filename inventory outside assigned task root and ps process check
probes.result: successful but unnecessarily broad; unrelated names/process details omitted from handoff
local archive creation/CRC/content validation required before carrier upload

actual_errors.literal_error: HTTPError: 400: GitHub Fetch URL contains an invalid repository path. (Response: None)
actual_errors.classification: connector URL validation failure; unintended invalid-path attempt, not proof branch or GitHub access is absent

review.status: pending; user assigns independent review and human delivery to coordinator; no reviewer invoked or approval claimed

artifact.transfer_status: local downloadable artifact prepared; persistent upload attempted after package freeze; see carrier response

remaining_unknowns: Tool availability/permissions and reliability beyond safe source/report probes
Unexpanded irrelevant schemas and backend tools outside registry
Precise model ID, reasoning effort, cost and usage
Whole cloud workflow correctness or efficiency
